title: Patient Accounting Calculation Memorandum: Rounding of Patient Payment Plans Add-On Amounts by Account Tenure
content:
The amount of a charge added to an active Patient Payment Plans plan is rounded once, at the end. How it is rounded follows how long the patient's Patient Financial Account has been open, in whole months from the date the account was opened to the enrollment date.

**Rounding rule.**

1. Account opened at least 120 whole months before the enrollment date: the add-on amount is rounded down to the whole dollar.
2. Account opened at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months before: it is rounded down to the half dollar.
3. Otherwise: it is rounded half up to the cent.

**Record read.** The opened date of the Patient Financial Account.

| Tenure of the account at the enrollment date | Rounding of the add-on amount | Unrounded 537.84 | Unrounded 537.49 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 120 whole months or more | Down to the whole dollar | 537.00 | 537.00 |
| 60 to 119 whole months | Down to the half dollar | 537.50 | 537.00 |
| Fewer than 60 whole months | Half up to the cent | 537.84 | 537.49 |

**Terms.** Rounding down to the half dollar takes the amount to the nearest 0.50 step at or below it (537.84 becomes 537.50; 537.49 becomes 537.00). Rounding half up to the cent takes an amount exactly halfway between two cents to the higher cent.

**Boundaries (hypothetical dates).** An account opened on 1 October 2016 has 120 whole months on 1 October 2026 and 119 on 30 September 2026; an account opened on 1 October 2021 has 60 whole months on 1 October 2026 and 59 on 30 September 2026.
